title: Chapter 294 Meeting With Soviet Revisionists
content:
Chapter 294 Meeting With Soviet Revisionists

"The surrounding areas of my Gaotang Village have been basically cleared."

"In Mulberry Village, there are no traces of the undead."

…

"Very good, then do you want to come and see what the undead army in Changping County looks like! Warm reminder, the undead army here is estimated to be at least 100,000."

"hiss……"

"This, this..."

"Lord Leader, have you already gone?"

"Well, I am currently outside Changping County, only twenty or thirty miles away from the undead army. Brothers, are you interested in coming with me to kill skeletons?"

At this time, all the lords were thinking in their minds.

The danger was temporarily lifted, and there was nothing to do except resume construction of the territory.

They have not forgotten that Wang Shuo said that with the merits of this battle, one can get the heart of the town.

But the danger of this trip is still quite high. If you want to follow Wang Shuo, you don't dare to do it if you don't have any strength.

"Okay, Lord Alliance Leader, wait for me, I will come to participate in this battle."

"I'm here to join in the fun."

"Mr. Meng Master, this... I won't join in the fun. In the previous defensive battle, the territory suffered heavy losses, and now there is no army expedition!"

Wang Shuo was deeply relieved to see someone responding. As for those who didn't come, he also expressed his understanding.

The destruction that the Burning Legion had done to them was really hard on them.

Half a day later, five lords from the Nanshan Association joined Wang Shuo with their troops.

Lin Xin from Luxi Village, Liu Zhiming from Gaotang Village, Wang Zhijing from Mulberry Village, Wen Yifan from Meilin Village, and Xu Pingwei from Xinxiang Village.

Each of these five villages brought 500 to 1,000 people.

Wang Shuo warmly received several people in the camp.

After seeing Wang Shuo's army, several people became more and more in awe of Wang Shuo.

"Thank you for coming and fighting alongside me."

"The leader is so polite. We would be very grateful if the leader can take us to play together."

After a few polite exchanges, Wang Shuo asked them to camp nearby and wait for unified action.

After seeing off a few people, a soldier came in and announced that Su Xiu from Jiuyuan Town was here to pay his respects.

Wang Shuo was shocked. Wang Shuo also wanted to meet this Su Xiu, but he didn't expect that the other party came to visit him first.

"Quick, please."

Soon, a majestic man wearing black gold armor walked into the tent, and Wang Shuo immediately stood up to greet him.

Su Xiu was not wearing a helmet. His sharp eyes and stern face looked full of majesty.

"Brother Su, although you and I have never met, we have been close friends for a long time!"

Wang Shuo walked over quickly.

"Brother Wang's reputation is like thunder to my ears! I happened to hear my subordinates say that you were also nearby, so I took the liberty to pay a visit. I hope I don't disturb Brother Wang."

Behind Su Xiu were two people with ferocious faces and fierce eyes. They seemed to be able to tear apart tigers and capture leopards.

They are really two tiger generals.

The two sat down.

Wang Shuo ordered people to serve tea and took a sip.

Su Xiu said: "Brother Wang, I wonder if you have any good ideas for this rescue battle?"

Wang Shuo shook his head and said with a smile: "I have just arrived here. I don't know much about the terrain and the enemy's overall situation, so I don't have any strategies."

"I have been surveying the surroundings for two days. The information I have found so far is that the total number of the undead army besieging Changping County is about 120,000, and the number is expected to increase. The supreme commander is a bloodthirsty demon wolf."

"We are now in the direction of the East City Gate of Changping County, and the one who besieged the East City Gate is the Wagner Division of the Burning Legion."

"The total number of troops in this department is 40,000, and the chief general, Wagner, is a top level 58 general. As for senior generals, there are at least a dozen."

High-level generals are equivalent to golden bosses, while top-level generals are equivalent to rare bosses.

As for the more advanced ones, whether they are beasts or humans, they all have extremely high IQs and are worthy of being warriors.
